evidence: The ﬁlm thicknesses were determined by ellipsometry and by X-ray ﬂuorescence spectrometry (XRFS) using a Spectrolab X2000 instrument. The purity of the ﬁlms was checked by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) with a Perkin-Elmer 5500 instrument using monochromated Al Kα radiation. The phase composition of the ﬁlms was examined by X-ray diffraction (XRD) using Cu Ka radiation in a Siemens D5000 instrument. The surface microstructure of the ﬁlms was studied with a high resolving Leo 1550 ﬁeld-emission gun-scanning electron microscope. Poly-Si/HfO2/Al capacitors were fabricated, and the capacitance was measured as a function of frequency with an HP4291A impedance/material analyzer in the frequency range of 1 MHz to 1.8 GHz. The dielectric constants of the ﬁlms were calculated from the capacitance values at 1 MHz. Leakage current measurements were performed with an HP4142B parameter analyzer. The ﬁlm thicknesses were determined by ellipsometry and by X-ray ﬂuorescence spectrometry (XRFS) using a Spectrolab X2000 instrument. The growth rate was determined from the thickness measurements. The QCM studies revealed the behavior of the QCM signal recorded during the ALD process.
